newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo level one ADR launched.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo level one ADR launched.

text.p: Russian regional utility Irkutskenergo has launched its level one American Depositary Receipt programme, financial consultant Brunswick said on Friday.
"The Irkutskenergo level one ADR is effective as of today," said Stephen Morrisey, head of corporate finance at Brunswick, adding that trading was beginning on Friday.
"The (U.S.) Securities and Exchange Commission has declared the registration statements effective," Morrisey said.
Brunswick brokerage was quoting the ADRs, each of which covers 50 underlying shares held by The Bank of New York, at $13.50/$14.50 in London.
Irkutskenergo rose sharply in morning trade in Moscow, firming to $0.281 at 1125 GMT, off a morning high near $0.33, and up from $0.242 at Thursday's close on the Russian Trading System.
